document.description: Valid Canadian visas can unlock visa-free or simplified access beyond passport privileges

unlocks.conditions: Hold a Canadian visa valid on the day of entry into Georgia and present the travel and/or other appropriate document proving its validity. Visa-free stays are limited to 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.

source.verificationPath: Legislative Herald of Georgia > Ordinance No 256 of 5 June 2015 > annex, Canada (item 22), and Notes 1-2
source.exactQuote: Aliens holding a visa and/or a residence permit of any country listed in the annex may enter and stay in Georgia without visa for 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.
source.validityQuote: For the purpose of entering and staying in Georgia without visa, a visa and/or a residence permit of a respective country shall be valid on the day of entry into Georgia (crossing the border), which must be evidenced by a travel and/or other appropriate document.
source.notes: The English page is the initial edition. Checked against the MFA-hosted Georgian consolidated text and the listed 17 April 2025 amendment; that amendment adds conditions for specified Gulf-state documents, not Canadian visas.

currentTextSource.verificationPath: MFA legal-act PDF > page 2, Canada (item 22); page 3, entry conditions 1-3

amendmentSource.verificationPath: Ordinance No 122 of 17 April 2025 > Article 1, addition of condition 3

unlocks.notes: This entry covers Canadian visas. The 90-day allowance is cumulative within any 180 days, not a fresh 90 days per entry. It does not establish permission to work, study or reside in Georgia; other entry requirements still apply.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid multiple-entry Canadian visa. The Belize entry-visa exemption is for visits not exceeding 30 days; a single-entry Canadian visa does not meet the stated exemption.

source.verificationPath: Belize Immigration > Visa > Do you need a visa to travel to Belize? > Exemption for Belize Entry Visa for visits not exceeding 30 days
source.exactQuote: If you hold a valid multiple entry visa or Permanent Residence Card from Canada
source.maximumStayQuote: Exemption for Belize Entry Visa for visits not exceeding 30 days.
source.notes: The source lists a valid Canadian multiple-entry visa or Canadian Permanent Residence Card as alternative qualifying documents in the same bullet; this entry records only the visa route. The exemption list does not impose a passport-nationality restriction.

unlocks.notes: This entry covers the Canadian multiple-entry visa exemption, not permanent residence or Canadian eTA. A visa waiver does not waive other admission requirements or guarantee 30 days. Staying beyond the initial 30 days requires the appropriate Belize visitor permit extension.

unlocks.conditions: Holders of valid foreign travel documents with a valid visa of Canada may enter, transit through and stay in Montenegro for up to 30 days, and no longer than until the expiry of the visa if the visa validity is less than 30 days.

source.verificationPath: Government of Montenegro > Ministry of Foreign Affairs > Visas > Do I need a visa for Montenegro? (bullet listing visa holders)
source.exactQuote: Holders of valid foreign travel documents with a valid Schengen visa, a valid visa of the Commonwealth of Australia, the Republic of Bulgaria, Japan, Canada, New Zealand, the Republic of Ireland, Romania, the United States of America Nationals of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland may enter, transit through and stay in Montenegro for up to 30 days, and no longer than until the expiry of the visa, if the validity of the visa is less than 30 days.
source.notes: Applies to holders of valid foreign travel documents with a valid Canadian visa (the provision lists Canada among qualifying visa-issuing countries).

unlocks.notes: Visa must be valid on entry; stay limited to up to 30 days or until visa expiry if shorter. Other entry requirements may apply.

unlocks.conditions: Holders of a valid visa or valid residence of Canada (among listed countries) are exempt from the tourist visa requirement to enter Panama.

source.verificationPath: Gaceta Oficial de Panamá > Decreto Ejecutivo N° 521 (2003) > Artículo 1
source.exactQuote: Artículo 1.- Se suprime el requisito de visa a los nacionales de los países que a continuación se indican, siempre que posean visa válida o residencia válida expedida por los Estados Unidos de América, Canadá, Australia, Reino Unido, Japón o por cualquiera de los Estados miembros de la Unión Europea: Andorra, Antigua y Barbuda, Argentina, Bahamas, Barbados, Belice, Brasil, Brunei Darussalam, Chile, Corea del Sur, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Granada, Guatemala, Honduras, Israel, Macedonia del Norte, Malasia, Mónaco, Nicaragua, Paraguay, Perú, San Cristóbal y Nieves, San Vicente y las Granadinas, Santa Lucía, Singapur, Taiwán, Trinidad y Tobago, Uruguay, Venezuela.
source.notes: As modified by Decreto Ejecutivo 196 (28 Oct 2024). The exemption applies to visa-required nationalities holding a valid visa/residence of Canada (among others).

unlocks.notes: Applies when entering as a non-resident tourist and the traveler would otherwise require a Panama visa; possession of a valid Canadian visa (or residence) satisfies the exemption. Standard tourist stay conditions apply.

unlocks.conditions: Holders of valid travel documents of third countries who hold a valid multiple-entry Canadian visa may enter North Macedonia without a short-stay visa (visa C) for up to 15 days per entry, within the limits of the temporary decision.

source.verificationPath: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of North Macedonia > Visa requirements > Decision on temporary abolition of visa regime
source.exactQuote: Holders of valid multiple-entry visas issued by the Schengen Area Member States, the United States of America, the United Kingdom and Canada are exempt from the visa requirement for a stay of up to 15 days. The validity of the visa must be at least 5 days longer than the duration of the stay.
source.notes: Temporary decision valid 1 Jan 2026 - 31 Dec 2026; requires valid multiple-entry Canadian visa inserted in passport and visa validity at least 5 days longer than planned stay.

unlocks.notes: Applies to third-country nationals otherwise requiring a visa; the Canadian visa must be multiple-entry and valid for at least 5 days beyond planned stay in North Macedonia.
